description: The price of a phone build that is handed back to the person as files, with a breakdown and a quote_id to pass to `release`. Read-only and free. An Android build is not charged on a paid plan (it uses about 40 of the plan's build minutes), and build_app does both steps for it. For `ios` it answers RELEASE_PLATFORM_UNAVAILABLE: iPhone builds are not available yet. Nothing is uploaded to the App Store or Google Play: the person uploads the file themselves, so never say an app was submitted or is being reviewed.

mode.description: Leave it out. A build is always handed back to the person as files.

platform.description: android works today; ios answers that iPhone builds are not available yet.

project.description: Project id (prj_…) or the app's name (slug). Defaults to the project in deploy.json in the current directory.

name: estimate_release
title: Price a phone build
